decisions.statement: LEND-L08-R2 (automatically resend a notice once its delivery has been unknown for 2 days or more) is not implemented. It contradicts the accepted DEC-008 ('When we do not know whether a notice arrived, we must not send it again automatically'), owned by the Head of Lending. R2 was requested by Customer Services, and the README says a requirement that contradicts an accepted decision is not a revision of it. send-notices keeps the L07/DEC-008 behaviour, and a test pins it.

The history is a new Tier 1 list, Library.NoticeHistory : SentNotice list (oldest first), with SentNotice = { Copy; Member; DueDate; SentOn; Delivery: SentNoticeDelivery }. SentNoticeDelivery has five cases: SentDelivered, SentRejected, SentDeliveryUnknown, SentConfirmedDelivered and SentConfirmedNotDelivered. Loan.Notice (U7-D1) is still the only thing that decides whether a loan needs a notice. The history is a record of what was sent and does not drive resending. It outlives returns, so a returned loan's notices stay listed.

Notices.recordSent appends one history entry for every notice sent, including rejected ones. Notices.confirm also updates the matching unknown entry (same copy, member, due date and day sent) to confirmed delivered or confirmed not delivered. The title is looked up from the copy's book when the history is shown, not stored.

Ordering (Notices.historyOf): newest day sent first, then copy id ascending (ordinal string order, as in the L07 copy-id ordering). Two notices for the same copy on the same day can happen when a rejected notice is sent again that day; they are listed most recently sent first.

Durability: JsonCodec writes a top-level 'noticeHistory' array, and the format stays 'lending/1' (following U6-D6/U7-D6). A store without 'noticeHistory' (written before L08) starts its history from the notices kept on its active loans (historyFromLoans). Notices that were rejected, confirmed not delivered, or on loans already returned before L08 were never stored, so they cannot be recovered.

CLI: 'notices <member>' renders Views.NoticeHistoryView. An unknown member gives the existing UnknownMember error. Help lists the command directly after confirm-notice, and so does the README command list.

openQuestions: LEND-L08-R2: Customer Services wants notices whose delivery has been unknown for 2 days or more resent automatically. Only the Head of Lending, as owner of DEC-008, can authorise this by issuing a new revision of DEC-008. Until then send-notices keeps staff follow-up through unknown-notices and confirm-notice.

The R1 example shows a 'delivered' notice on 2026-04-02 after an 'unknown' one on 2026-03-30 for the same copy. Under DEC-008 that sequence only happens through a confirm-notice (which shows as 'confirmed not delivered') or a new due date, so the example appears to assume R2.
rejectedAssumptions: LEND-L08-R2 presents an automatic resend after 2 days of unknown delivery as decided policy. It is not: accepted DEC-008 (owner Head of Lending) forbids an automatic resend of a notice whose delivery is unknown, and the README says a requirement that contradicts an accepted decision does not revise it. Found by reading docs/decisions/DEC-008-overdue-notices.md and README.md.
